name: KORLIX Brain+Voice
googleShortDescription: Talk with Rici and save memories and instructions to your KORLIX brain.
description:
Meet Rici, your voice companion in KORLIX Brain+Voice. Talk through ideas, save useful details, and shape how your assistant responds.

TALK NATURALLY
Start Live Conversation, speak with Rici, and stop whenever you choose. Use Deep Think when you want a more considered answer. A short welcome and adjustable background ambience help you settle in.

SAY IT AND SAVE IT
While a voice session is active, say "Rici, remember this" followed by a memory or instruction. Rici saves it to your signed-in KORLIX brain without asking for another password. You receive confirmation after the save succeeds. Ordinary conversation does not automatically become long-term memory.

MAKE YOUR BRAIN YOURS
Open My Brain to review saved memories and remove items you no longer want. Add typed notes or select a document to create a draft you can review before saving. Train My AI lets you add instructions and knowledge that personalize Rici's responses.

KEEP THE USEFUL PARTS
Save, share or delete individual transcript messages. Saved transcript messages remain on your device and are separate from Brain memories. Sharing opens your device's share sheet with the selected message.

MONTHLY PLAN AND OPTIONAL AI GAS
Brain+Voice Monthly includes Personal Brain, Train My AI and 60 Live Conversation minutes per monthly billing period for US $34.99. Included minutes reset each period and do not roll over. Optional AI GAS purchases add 60, 120 or 180 Live minutes for US $30, $55 or $80. Purchased AI GAS does not expire and is used after your included minutes. Deep Think has separate existing account limits.

The monthly subscription renews automatically unless canceled through your store account. Review the localized price and terms shown by your store before purchasing. No free trial is included. Manage your subscription and restore eligible purchases from Plan & AI GAS.

YOUR KORLIX ACCOUNT
Use your existing KORLIX account. Memories and instructions connect to your shared general Rici agent.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
Start and stop voice from the app, review your memories, and report a response when something is wrong. Voice requires microphone permission and an internet connection. AI responses may be inaccurate; check important information. For users aged 16 and older; users aged 16 or 17 need parent or guardian permission.

Rici is pronounced Ree-see.
